type.description: The type of the notification channel.
type.rationale: Channel type is a functional setting with no direct security impact.

labels.description: Configuration fields that define the channel and its behavior. Sensitive credentials such as auth_token, password, and service_key must NOT be placed here.
labels.rationale: Placing sensitive credentials such as auth_token, password, or service_key in labels exposes them in plain text in Terraform state and GCP API responses. Credentials must be placed in the sensitive_labels block instead.

sensitive_labels.description: Labels which contain secrets or passwords so that they can be marked sensitive and hidden from plan output.
sensitive_labels.rationale: When credentials are placed in sensitive_labels, they are masked by GCP and not exposed in API responses. This is the correct location for sensitive credentials.

auth_token.description: An authorization token for a notification channel.
auth_token.rationale: When placed in sensitive_labels, the value is masked by GCP and not exposed in API responses.

password.description: A password for a notification channel.
password.rationale: When placed in sensitive_labels, the value is masked by GCP.

service_key.description: A service key token for a notification channel.
service_key.rationale: When placed in sensitive_labels, the value is masked by GCP.

user_labels.description: User-supplied key/value data for organizing and identifying the NotificationChannel objects.
user_labels.rationale: Organisational metadata with no security impact.

description.description: An optional human-readable description of this notification channel.
description.rationale: Descriptive field with no security impact.

display_name.description: An optional human-readable name for this notification channel.
display_name.rationale: Display metadata with no security impact.

enabled.description: Whether notifications are forwarded to the described channel.
enabled.rationale: Disabling a channel is a legitimate operational choice and does not create a security risk on its own.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Organisational field, not a security control.

force_delete.description: If true, the channel will be deleted even if referenced by alert policies.
force_delete.rationale: Forcing deletion of a channel still referenced by alert policies silently removes active alerting, creating a gap in incident detection and response.
